title: Preference pivots update the existing fact instead of duplicating it
description: When a stored preference is superseded (npm -> pnpm), the canonical update operation changes the existing fact instead of creating a duplicate.
contract_notes: The deterministic journey captures the seeded canonical FactId and updates that exact fact through the retained surface.

facts.content: User prefers npm as the package manager for this project.
